verdict.credibility_line: Management meets FY26 margin promises but consistently falls short on FY27 EBIT margin guidance.

promises.delivered: Actual PAT margin FY26 was 12.65% (PAT 1865 cr / revenue 14748 cr)

promises.promise: Maintain operating margin near 15.6% and PAT margin around 12.6% for FY26

promises.delivered: Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026) EBITDA margin 13.6% (used as proxy for EBIT)

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: EBIT margin for Q2 FY27 was 15%
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: EBITDA margin was 13.6% in Sep 2026 quarter

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Adjusted PAT margin would have been 13.4%

guidance_now: FY27 revenue growth 20% YoY to USD 487.6M in Q2 FY27.
Raise USD 1.25B debt/equity, refinance bridge loan.
Allocate USD 25-30M in next two quarters for transaction costs.
Cash and investments increase to ~$315M by end of Q2 FY27.
bull: FY26 PAT margin close to guidance and operating margin exceeds it.
Revenue growth remains robust, FY26 revenue up 25% YoY.
Cash flow strong with FCF 1572 cr in FY26.
bear: EBIT margin fell short of FY27 target of 16‑17%.
FY27 EBIT margin of 15% not achieved; actual ~13.6%.
Guidance on FY27 revenue remains unverified, raising execution risk.
questions: What is the expected FY27 full-year revenue, and when will it be disclosed?
How do you reconcile the FY27 EBIT margin guidance of 16‑17% with the 13.6% margin observed in Q2?
Can you provide a detailed capex plan for FY27, including expected investing cash outflow?
